profile.headline: Developer at Cadmium
profile.summary:
I am a developer who has a passion for learning new frameworks, languages and design patterns.  Primarily I have experience with .NET C# for backend development, and use React/Vue for front end work. I also have experience using  Azure DevOps, with some experience configuring CI/CD pipelines. Azure is my primary platform for hosting apps and services.

My favorite development framework for personal projects is Blazor, which has translated well to JavaScript frameworks like Vue and React. I am interested in learning all types of programming ranging from web development to systems development.

positions.title: Software Application Developer
positions.description: Develop web and desktop applications to assist throughout the Distribution Center. Maintain and contribute to a production SqlServer instance. Maintain new and legacy web applications (VB.Net & Classic ASP, C# MVC .Net Core 2.2, Blazor Server .Net 5.0). Provide general IT support to operators and office staff.

positions.title: Business Analyst Co-Op
positions.description:
SAP parameter management for multiple value streams
Developed Excel and BI reporting packages and tools for operational teams
Supply Chain dashboards and reporting tools in support of Lean Enterprise Management Systems
Inventory Management support including cycle counting and root cause countermeasure

positions.title: Business Analyst Co-Op
positions.description:

positions.title: Information Systems Co-Op
positions.description:
Project management coordinator for campus productivity tools
